name: lubyvet
description: LubyVet: sistema de balcão de clínica veterinária

scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/contracts build && bun run --cwd apps/api build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/contracts typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/api typecheck
scripts.test:unit: bun run --cwd packages/contracts test:unit && bun run --cwd apps/api test:unit
scripts.test:cov: bun run --cwd packages/contracts test:cov && bun run --cwd apps/api test:cov
scripts.verify: bun run --cwd packages/contracts build && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun run boundaries && bun run test:cov && bun run test:int && bun run test:e2e
